name: Cosmic Voice
body:
School enchantment (mind-affecting); Level bard 5, mesmerist 5, psychic 6, sorcerer/wizard 6, witch 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 20 ft.

Area radius burst centered on you
Duration instantaneous, see text
Saving Throw Will partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You speak with a voice that transcends reality and shakes the mortal fabric of your enemies within the area. Each enemy within the burst of sound must make a Will save. On a failure, they suffer a condition as noted on the table below. On a success, they are treated as one HD category higher than they are on the table. If they were already greater than your CL and make the Will save, they are unaffected.
